about: Lancaster Sensorimotor Norms (Lynott et al. 2020, Behavior Research Methods): 39,707 English words rated 0-5 for six perceptual modalities and five action effectors. Column names follow the published CSV (Word, Haptic.mean, ...) but have not been checked against the file; if they differ, normcheck lists the real headers. Words in that file are upper case, so they are lowercased before asking. The questions paraphrase the original instructions.

touch.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by feeling through touch?

hearing.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by hearing?

sight.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by seeing?

smell.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by smelling?

taste.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by tasting?

interoception.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by sensations inside your body?

foot_leg.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by performing an action with your foot or leg?

hand_arm.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by performing an action with your hand or arm?

head.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by performing an action with your head, not counting the mouth?

mouth.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by performing an action with your mouth or throat?

torso.instructions: To what extent do you experience what this word means by performing an action with your torso?
